firefoxWithoutAutomation.sameBinary: Playwright Firefox155 macOS arm64 launched directly without Juggler or Playwright

open.detail: Playwright Firefox155 on macOS arm64 sometimes crashes its DOM Worker thread after reconnect starts a new worker, immediate cancellation/emptying, then navigation. Also reproduced with isolated FlowLayout. Native simple/ELK Worker immediate-termination controls and ten uninstrumented engine cycles pass. Instrumentation affects timing but is not the cause established: a compiled uninstrumented viewer run also crashed. No browser-specific delay or main-thread fallback added. Need an independent full-browser reproduction or worker-runtime/browser correction before final release readiness. A later direct launch of the same Firefox binary, without Playwright/Juggler, completed twenty self-driven reconnect/cancel/navigation cycles. This narrows the reproduction but does not establish a fixed root cause. Adding 0/5/10/16/30/60 ms timing variation to that direct launch reproduces SIGSEGV after two completed cycles. It is not limited to active Playwright control, though this remains the Playwright-patched Firefox binary rather than a separate official release. Official Mozilla Firefox156.0.1, verified against its published SHA-512 and macOS code signature, passes all twenty identical timing-varied cycles. The specific difference causing the older patched155 crash is unverified. Use the current official-browser check for this regression; M25 must preserve it rather than silently dropping the case.
open.status: Current unmodified release passes; retain the failing patched-runtime reproduction without a source workaround.
